definitions.explanation: A flat container for serving food.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}いお{皿|さら}に{料理|りょうり}を{盛|も}る。
examples.english: To serve food on a white plate.

examples.japanese: お{皿|さら}を{割|わ}ってしまった。

notes:
お{皿|さら} is {皿|さら} (plate/dish) with the polite prefix お, commonly used in everyday speech.

WORD FORMATION:
お (polite prefix) + {皿|さら} (plate)

COUNTER:
{枚|まい} for flat objects: {一枚|いちまい}、{二枚|にまい}

COMMON VERBS:
- お{皿|さら}を{洗|あら}う: to wash dishes
- お{皿|さら}を{並|なら}べる: to set the table
- お{皿|さら}に{盛|も}る: to serve on a plate
- お{皿|さら}を{片付|かたづ}ける: to clear the dishes

TYPES OF DISHES:
- {大皿|おおざら}: large plate/platter
- {小皿|こざら}: small plate
- {取|と}り{皿|ざら}: individual serving plate

RELATED TABLEWARE:
{茶碗|ちゃわん} (rice bowl), {箸|はし} (chopsticks), コップ (cup)
